Here’s how **login works for the two different IBM event sites you mentioned** and what credentials you should use:

---

## 🔐 1. **IBM Dev Day (BeMyApp platform)**

- The Dev Day event platform at `https://ibm-devday.bemyapp.com/` is run through **BeMyApp**, which is an event platform. citeturn0search6
- When it asks you to **“Sign in”** and you used **Gmail / app passcode**, that is *not* an IBM corporate account login — it’s just the event platform’s authentication.  
  - You registered for the event, likely clicked “Sign in with Google/Gmail”, and entered a Gmail app-specific password (if 2FA was on).  
  - This **logs you into the DevDay event portal only** — for viewing schedule, sessions, hackathon info, etc. citeturn0search6

**Key point:**  
✔ That login is **not the same as your IBM corporate credentials**.

---

## 🔐 2. **IBM WatsonX Challenge / Hackathon Portal**

- The hackathon site you referenced (`https://compete.0126hackathon.watsonx-challenge.ibm.com/` — same type used in 2025/2026 watsonx hackathons) **expects an IBMid login** — not the event platform login.  
- IBMid is the official universal IBM login used for IBM SaaS products, cloud services, training, certifications, WatsonX products, etc. citeturn0search3

### **Which credentials to use here:**

✅ **Your IBMid email and password**  
• This is the same IBM corporate account you would use for:  
 • IBM Cloud  
 • IBM Training & Certifications  
 • watsonx services  
 • Developer credentials

If you **don’t have an IBMid yet**:  
➡ Go to the IBMid creation page and register with the *same email* you used for the Dev Day hackathon registration (so they link your registration). citeturn0search3

---

## 🧠 Why this difference exists

- **BeMyApp event login (Gmail SSO)** = temporary event access to view event content and schedule. citeturn0search6  
- **IBMid login** = universal IBM identity for participating in services like the hackathon platform hosted on IBM infrastructure. citeturn0search3

Your Dev Day event login **will not automatically authenticate you into the hackathon portal** unless it uses IBMid behind the scenes — which it typically doesn’t for BeMyApp sessions.

---

## 🔑 Steps to successfully log into the Hackathon

1. **Create or confirm your IBMid**  
   - Use the same email address you used to register for the hackathon.
   - Set a password that you can remember, or complete the registration flow. citeturn0search3

2. **Go to the hackathon login page** at `https://compete.0126hackathon.watsonx-challenge.ibm.com/`

3. **Sign in with IBMid (email + IBMid password)**  
   - If prompted, complete any two-factor authentication.

4. If access issues show up, check hackathon registration emails — often they include a specific link or access token.

---

## ✔ Summary

| Site | What Login Works | Notes |
|------|----------------|-------|
| `ibm-devday.bemyapp.com` | Gmail / event platform login | Only gives access to event content |
| `compete.0126hackathon.watsonx-challenge.ibm.com` | **IBMid (email + IBM password)** | Required for hackathon submission portal |

---

If you want, I can walk you through **creating an IBMid step-by-step** or check what email you need registered for the hackathon — just tell me!
